description: TikTok Intelligence ET: list Seller Product API.

pageSize.description: Number of items per page. **must be a multiple of 10, the maximum is 100**; the upper limit of a single page in the official interface is 10, internally it is 10 after multiple pulls per page and then merged

sellerId.description: Store ID (TikTok Shop store ID). Maximum length 1000. Obtained from the returned results of the "ET TikTok Store Search" or "ET TikTok Store Details" skills

sellerProductSortField.description: List sorting fields: 1=Total sales (total_sale_cnt), 2=Total sales (total_sale_gmv_amt), 3=SPU average price (spu_avg_price), 4=7-day sales (total_sale_7d_cnt), 5=7-day sales (total_sale_gmv_7d_amt)
